jobs.title: Data Engineer, WW Ops Finance S&A
jobs.description: Are you passionate about standardizing data platforms and automating data engineering to drive analytics and reporting? Do you excel in dynamic, fast-paced environments and find joy in converting data into actionable insights? Are you adept at implementing data governance practices and defining data access and quality standards? If you thrive in innovation and can deliver scalable Data Engineering Solutions, then the Worldwide Operations Finance Standardization & Automation (S&A) team has an exciting opportunity for you! We are seeking a customer-centric Data Engineer to establish a reliable and accessible data platform, ensuring Operations Finance customers have complete trust in the data, technology, and tools to make data-driven business decisions. We are looking for a top-notch Data Engineer to be part of our Global Data Delivery organization, working with one of the world's largest and most complex data warehouse environments. As a Data Engineer in WW Ops S&A, you will design, implement and support scalable data infrastructure solutions and implement complex data models for Amazon Customer Fulfillment business. You will create solutions to integrate with multi heterogeneous data sources, aggregate and retrieve data in a fast and safe mode, curate data that can be used in reporting, analysis, GenAI models and ad-hoc data requests. You should have excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with business owners, Finance and Product teams along with tech leaders to gather infrastructure requirements, design data infrastructure, build up data pipelines and data-sets to meet business needs. You will be responsible for developing and operating a data service platform using Python, Airflow, and SQL to build various ETL, analytics, and data quality components. You'll automate deployments using AWS CodeDeploy, AWS CodePipeline, AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK), and AWS Cloud Formation. You will work with AWS services like Redshift, Glue, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and more. Strong experience in Data Warehouse and Business Intelligence application development, expert knowledge in SQL query optimization, and experience with programming languages such as Scala/Python are essential for this role. Key job responsibilities • Design, build, and maintain complex data solutions and ETL pipelines using Python, Spark, SQL, and AWS services (S3, Glue, Redshift, MWAA, EMR, Lambda) • Develop high-quality data architecture and scalable pipelines to support customer reporting needs, while implementing and supporting analytics infrastructure for internal Finance customers • Interface with technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from various sources, ensuring data quality and making appropriate trade-offs in design decisions • Collaborate with business users, developers, and BI Engineers to deliver on data architecture projects and next-generation financial solutions • Actively participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team planning, while continually improving reporting processes and automating self-service support • Identify and implement process improvements to drive innovation, scale existing solutions, and create new ones based on stakeholder needs • Diagnose and resolve operational issues through detailed root cause analysis, maintaining high standards of system availability and reliability About the team The Operations finance data ecosystem supports global data management solutions inclusive of the scaling solutions to support 10+ data producer teams and 2500 finance customers. The role will work with BIE/DE teams across the organization, identifying critical customer pain points and help design , implement and drive customer's data journey. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - AgentCore, AWS Agentic AI
jobs.description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is building the foundational services developers use to create, deploy, and operate production-ready AI agents at scale. AgentCore Harness, launched at AWS Summit New York in June 2026, provides a managed agent loop that enables customers to define an agent through configuration rather than build and operate orchestration infrastructure themselves. Customers specify their model, instructions, tools, skills, memory, and execution limits. AgentCore Harness manages the agent loop, secure execution environment, session isolation, identity, networking, observability, and deployment lifecycle. This allows developers to move quickly from an idea to a production agent while retaining the flexibility to integrate custom tools, models, and environments. As a Software Development Engineer, you will design, implement, test, deploy, and operate core components across the Harness control plane and data plane. You will solve challenging distributed systems problems involving agent execution, session state, tool orchestration, security, scalability, reliability, and low-latency streaming. You will own features throughout their lifecycle, contribute to technical designs, and deliver high-quality solutions for customers. Harness sits at the intersection of AgentCore Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Observability, Browser, Code Interpreter, and Evaluations. You will collaborate with engineers across these services to integrate capabilities, improve cross-service APIs, and reduce friction throughout the agent development lifecycle. A central part of this role is making sophisticated agent capabilities dramatically easier to use. You will work backward from customer needs to turn complex infrastructure and orchestration tasks into intuitive configuration, sensible defaults, reusable templates, and guided workflows. Your work will help customers move from an idea to a secure, observable, production-ready agent in minutes while preserving the flexibility advanced builders need for customization. You will help develop capabilities that make agent development faster and more accessible. This may include simplifying how customers connect tools and memory, building richer agent templates and skills, automating permissions and resource wiring, shortening the build-test-deploy loop, and creating safer ways to evaluate and release changes. This is an opportunity to join a newly launched service at an early stage, contribute to its architecture and customer experience, and deliver capabilities with broad industry impact. Machine learning experience is helpful but not required. We are looking for strong engineers with distributed systems experience, sound technical judgment, a commitment to operational excellence, and the ability to deliver in a fast-moving environment. Key job responsibilities - Design, build, test, deploy, and operate highly available control plane APIs, data plane services, and managed agent loops for production AI agents. - Build secure, isolated execution capabilities spanning tool orchestration, memory, context management, streaming, identity, networking, observability, and failure handling. - Develop integrations between Amazon Bedrock and third-party models, AgentCore services, MCP servers, AWS Step Functions, Strands Agents, and customer-defined environments. - Implement versioning, endpoints, progressive deployment, rollback, evaluation, and optimization capabilities that help customers safely improve agent behavior. - Analyze and improve latency, scalability, availability, resource efficiency, and cost controls across multi-tenant workloads. - Simplify the developer journey across APIs, SDKs, CLI, console, infrastructure as code, and local workflows by building cohesive abstractions, templates, defaults, and automation. - Work directly with customers and partner teams to identify and reduce friction, accelerate time to production, and balance approachable experiences with the flexibility advanced builders need. - Contribute to architectural decisions within Harness and collaborate with teams across AgentCore. jobs.title: Data Scientist, FX Quantitative Research
jobs.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data scientists and data analysts learn and grow together. The Treasury Finance Data Science team builds the models, risk frameworks, and decision tools behind how Stripe manages money at global scale: liquidity, funding, counterparty risk, and foreign exchange. Stripe moves funds across 135+ currencies every day. That creates FX exposure from merchant flows, multi-currency balances, and entity funding. In this role, you'll be a thought partner and builder alongside Stripe's FX team. Together you'll develop the quantitative foundation for how Stripe measures, forecasts, and hedges FX exposure. What you'll do You'll be the senior quantitative lead for FX within Treasury Finance Data Science. You'll co-build with Treasury, the FX hedging team, Finance, and Engineering: shaping the research agenda, turning ideas into rigorous models, and building the systems that put those models to work. Data Science owns these systems. They produce the decision-critical outputs and analyses that the FX team and Treasury leadership rely on. This is a hands-on role. You'll design the methodology, write the code, and ship it into production. Responsibilities Partner with the FX team to build and evolve FX risk measurement: exposure aggregation across entities and currencies, VaR / Expected Shortfall, stress testing, and scenario analysis Develop forecasting models for FX exposures and multi-currency cash flows. Quantify forecast uncertainty so it can inform hedge sizing and timing. Co-design hedge optimization and decision frameworks with the FX team that weigh hedge cost, residual risk, P&L volatility, and liquidity constraints Build ML and statistical systems for trading and risk (signal research, anomaly detection on flows, execution and cost analytics), and take them from prototype to production Own the production systems that generate decision-critical FX outputs, partnering with Engineering on reliability, SLAs, monitoring, alerting, and incident response for risk-critical workflows Partner deeply with Treasury Finance stakeholders to turn business questions into quantitative frameworks. Anticipate needs and help shape FX risk strategy rather than reacting to requests. Produce clear, trusted analyses and reporting that inform Treasury and Finance leadership decisions, including leadership-level reporting such as MBRs and QBRs Use AI tools (code assistants, LLM-based agents) to speed up modeling, analysis, and automation, while maintaining rigor, validation, and auditability Raise the technical bar for FX quantitative work within Data Science: methodology standards, model validation, documentation, and mentoring other data scientists Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Location Requirement New York, NY required (50% in office - hybrid) Minimum requirements PhD with 1-3 years, MS or MA with 2-6 years, or BS or BA with 4-8 years of data science or quantitative modeling experience Hands-on quantitative experience at a bank, asset manager, hedge fund, trading firm, or similar financial institution, with direct exposure to FX, rates, or market risk Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and time-series modeling, plus working knowledge of risk measures (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress testing) and hedging instruments (forwards, swaps, options) Proficiency in Python and SQL. You write production-quality code, not just research scripts. Experience taking models or analytical systems from research into production Business acumen and the ability to turn complex analyses into clear, decision-ready insights Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact with cross-functional partners, including senior non-technical stakeholders Ability to manage multiple projects at once, with strong attention to detail Experience using AI tools to speed up modeling, analysis, and coding Preferred qualifications Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Quantitative / Mathematical Finance, Financial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Economics, Operations Research) Applied machine learning experience in trading or risk (e.g., forecasting, execution analytics, signal research, anomaly detection) Experience with corporate treasury or balance-sheet FX: multi-entity exposure management, hedge programs, and treasury concepts such as liquidity, funding, and cash positioning Experience building risk or decision systems with engineering standards: code review, testing, monitoring, and defined SLAs Experience with distributed data tools (e.g., Spark) and workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Flyte) Prior experience at a growth-stage internet, fintech, or payments company Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs and MBRs A builder's mindset, with a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom Interest in how data products enable automated and agentic workflows, and an understanding that model and data quality determine the reliability of every downstream decision

jobs.description: We see our customers as invited guests to a party, and we are the hosts. It's our job every day to make every important aspect of the customer experience a little bit better." - Jeff Bezos, Founder & CEO We didn’t make Amazon a trillion-dollar company, our customers did, and we want to ensure that our customers always have a positive experience that keeps them coming back to Amazon. To help achieve this, the Customer Experience Improvement (CXI) team, within Amazon Customer Service (CS), relentlessly focuses on maintaining customer trust by building products that offer appropriate resolutions to resolve issues faced by our customers. CXI engineers solve complex problems and build scalable, robust solutions to help our customers navigate through issues and eliminate systemic defects to prevent future issues and identify critical customer experience improvement opportunities. This role will leverage latest technologies and Agentic AI solutions to autonomously eliminate defects at scale to improve customer experience. Key job responsibilities - Design, develop, and own scalable solutions that empower Amazon to deliver a defect-free experience for customers. - Build intuitive tools for Customer Service Associates (CSAs) to escalate critical issues, and develop complex integrations with Tier-1 Amazon systems and advanced science models to detect, triage, and resolve systemic defects. - Tackle complex technical challenges, create innovative solutions with direct impact on customer trust, and work on systems critical to Amazon's operational excellence. ARCADE leverages AI to transform how we detect repeat negative customer experiences and eliminate the underlying upstream defects at scale. The CXI Tech team re-imagines how we leverage customer interactions and feedback — through modular capabilities spanning Detection, Triage, Root Cause, Attribution, and Resolution — to enable more reliable and faster defect elimination that drives customer experience improvements throughout the consumer business. jobs.title: Robotics Data Engineer, Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR)
jobs.description: Are you interested in solving the most critical operations problem behind cutting-edge robotics development? Interested in fast dynamic environment? Amazon's Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR) team is building advanced robotic systems through frontier foundation models, and high-quality data collection is a core input to that research. Key job responsibilities Own the technical execution and continuous improvement of early-stage data collection for advanced robotics. Partner with researchers to translate research objectives into reliable collection workflows, improve data quality, and shorten policy training iteration cycles. Work independently within agreed priorities, providing hands-on technical guidance to data collectors and coordinating execution across research, engineering, and operations. In this role, you will - Own end to end collection iterations for assigned research tasks, from requirements and station readiness through pilot data collection, quality review, and delivery of training-ready data. jobs.description: DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk. Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets. We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus. As a Software Engineer – Trading Operations , you’ll provide support to a group of trading desks based in London, Singapore and Chicago. Build, maintain and extend trading related applications, data pipelines, and solutions. Work with both greenfield and legacy systems across multiple languages (Java, Python) Provide on-call support as needed. Requirements Exceptional interpersonal skills - you communicate clearly with stakeholders as well as other engineers, fostering a collaborative, supportive working environment. Strong track record in working with in enterprise scale software engineering projects, and be capable of delivering and managing dynamic software projects for key stakeholders Substantial prior interaction with the front office and senior management in an active trading environment. 2+ years of enterprise experience working on systems involving the use of Version Control, Git, Python/Java, Linux The ability to work comfortably in multiple programming languages is a big plus. 2-3 years of experience strongly preferred in front office, middle office, back office, or risk management roles working with exchange traded and OTC Products. Substantial prior interaction with the front office and senior management in an active trading environment Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field or material equivalent exposure Demonstrated ability to work independently, break down problems, and synthesize and implement solutions The annual base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $175,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set.
